sources.title: Disputes Learning Hub for merchants using a Merchant Services Provider
sources.scope: US; TPP merchant support; page includes 2025 data and older embedded-video transcripts
sources.evidence: Public guidance distinguishes inquiry and upfront chargeback routes, merchant-provider responses, recognizable receipts and pending refund visibility.
sources.limitations: Program-specific public education; not the complete merchant agreement. Different statistics refer to different years; no performance percentages reused. Video transcripts read, videos not watched.

sources.title: Request a refund of a credit balance
sources.evidence: Account selection and an overpayment/credit-balance request are distinct from disputing a merchant purchase.
sources.limitations: Does not establish closed-account routing, third-party-funded refunds, eligibility decisions or a turnaround promise.

sources.title: How can I dispute a charge?
sources.scope: US cardmember billing help; undated FAQ
sources.evidence: Links a dispute request to a selected transaction and recommends contacting the merchant first.
sources.limitations: Not a requirement to delay reporting suspected fraud. Does not disclose complete reason-specific rights, role eligibility or outcomes.

sources.title: Payment returned for insufficient or uncollected funds
sources.scope: US; terms depend on Cardmember Agreement; undated FAQ
sources.evidence: Returned payment can involve contractual fees and conditional re-presentation.
sources.limitations: No Etail fee or retry count is adopted; bank restrictions affect whether a payment can be re-presented.

sources.title: Differences between balances shown online
sources.scope: US Basic Card Member; undated FAQ
sources.evidence: Distinguishes statement, remaining statement and total balance, including how credits, disputes and returned payments affect them.
sources.limitations: Amex product definitions and minimum-payment wording do not override Etail pay-in-full or guardian-funded products; not a live screen audit.

sources.title: Financial struggles and payment accommodation
sources.scope: US; eligible account/program terms; undated FAQ
sources.evidence: Payment assistance may be available and enrollment affects card use.
sources.limitations: Not an entitlement to relief or an Etail lending/fee policy. Exact eligibility and servicing actions are not fully public here.

sources.title: Check dispute status
sources.scope: US online dispute overview; undated FAQ
sources.evidence: Describes dispute status, supporting documents, draft editing and closure actions.
sources.limitations: Permitted actions still depend on live case and authority; no authenticated walkthrough performed.

sources.title: Time to resolve a dispute case
sources.evidence: Provides typical and complex-case timing plus a status-check route.
sources.limitations: General expectation, not every case's deadline, legal filing period, merchant response deadline or Etail service promise.

excluded.topic: US merchant reference/regulation PDFs and network operational manuals
excluded.reason: Explicit confidentiality markings or login-gated complete terms. Public operating/help sources used instead; missing terms remain gaps.
Not imported as US operating rules; source was a search lead only.

excluded.topic: Third-party chargeback summaries and forum anecdotes
excluded.reason: Not used as Amex policy authority.
